0022600104.text: The Hornets, 1-1 and 8th in the East, host the 0-2 Miami Heat, who are 15th in the East, in Charlotte's third game of the season. The last meeting was a 136-106 Hornets win in Charlotte on March 17, 2026, and Charlotte lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, with no games yet in 2026-27. Out for Charlotte are Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), while Christian Anderson (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Miami's Pelle Larsson (finger sprain) is also day-to-day and a game-time decision.
